headline: House votes to spike impeachment while Senate advances college sports bill with cloture motion!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate voted 74-24 to advance cloture on the motion to proceed to S. 4668, the Protect College Sports Act. A cloture motion on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (H.R. 3633) failed 49-50. Matthew R. Byrne was confirmed as U.S. District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio with a 52-45 vote.

onTheFloor.title: Protect College Sports Act - protects student-athletes' name, image, and likeness rights and promotes fair competition in college athletics
onTheFloor.status: Cloture agreed 74-24, debate continues post-cloture at 10 a.m. Wednesday

onTheFloor.title: Digital Asset Market Clarity Act - regulates digital commodities and central bank digital currency
onTheFloor.status: Cloture motion rejected 49-50, motion to reconsider entered

onTheFloor.title: United States District Judge for the Southern District of Ohio

house.lastSessionSummary: The House voted 232-147 with 47 answering present to table an impeachment resolution against Donald John Trump. Multiple suspension bills passed with strong bipartisan votes including elder fraud protections (414-7), whistleblower protections (424-0), and the War Powers resolution directing removal of forces from Iran (220-204).

onTheFloor.title: Impeachment resolution against President Donald John Trump
